Customer Centricity
Customer Centricity is a core value, guiding all decisions to prioritize customer benefit.

Version 4.0
Version 4.0 is the current iteration of the employee handbook.

Agentic House Vietnam
Agentic House Vietnam is the company for which this employee handbook is created, aiming to be a leading B2B AI company in Southeast Asia by 2030.

Employee Handbook
This handbook serves as a guide for employees to understand Agentic House Vietnam's culture, working methods, and essential information.<SEP>A document containing company policies and useful information.

2030
2030 is the target year for Agentic House Vietnam to achieve its vision of becoming the leading B2B AI company in Southeast Asia.<SEP>Năm mà Agentic House đặt mục tiêu trở thành công ty AI B2B hàng đầu Đông Nam Á.

Vision
The vision of Agentic House Vietnam is to become the leading B2B AI company in Southeast Asia by 2030, with products and services used by 10,000 businesses in the region.

January 1, 2024
January 1, 2024, is the effective date of the employee handbook version 4.0.

Fun And Meaningful Work
Fun And Meaningful Work is a core value, recognizing that a significant portion of life is spent at work and it should be valuable.

Continuous Learning
Continuous Learning is a core value, emphasizing the need to adapt to rapid technological changes.

Ownership Of Results
Ownership Of Results is a core value, encouraging finding solutions and taking responsibility without blame or excuses.

Candor And Respect
Candor And Respect is a core value, promoting honest and direct feedback with a constructive attitude.

Engineering Department
The Engineering Department is responsible for product and solution development.

Product Department
The Product Department is responsible for product strategy and roadmap.

Data & AI Department
The Data & AI Department is responsible for AI research and implementation.

Mission
The mission of Agentic House Vietnam is to build practical AI solutions to help Vietnamese and Southeast Asian businesses operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably.

HR Department
The HR Department is responsible for human resources and culture.

Finance Department
The Finance Department is responsible for finance and accounting.

Sales & BD Department
The Sales & BD Department is responsible for business and market development.

Legal & Compliance Department
The Legal & Compliance Department is responsible for legal affairs and compliance.

Customer Success Department
The Customer Success Department is responsible for customer care and retention.

Marketing Department
The Marketing Department is responsible for brand and marketing.

Ho Chi Minh City Office
The Ho Chi Minh City Office is a branch of Agentic House Vietnam, located at Tầng 8, Tòa nhà XYZ, 456 Nguyễn Huệ, Quận 1, HCM.

Monday To Friday
Monday to Friday are the standard working days.

Da Nang Office
The Da Nang Office is a small branch of Agentic House Vietnam, accommodating 10 people, located at Số 789 Nguyễn Văn Linh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng.

Hanoi Office
The Hanoi Office is the headquarters of Agentic House Vietnam, located at Tầng 12, Tòa nhà ABC, 123 Lý Thường Kiệt, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội.

Standard Working Hours Policy
The Standard Working Hours Policy defines working hours from Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00, with a one-hour lunch break.

Work From Home Policy
The Work From Home Policy allows eligible employees to work from home up to 2 days/week with prior manager approval.

Saturday, Sunday
Saturday and Sunday are days off, except for special requests with overtime pay.

Flexible Hours Policy
The Flexible Hours Policy allows employees to start between 8:00-10:00 and end accordingly, provided they are present during 'core hours'.

Core Hours
Khoảng thời gian từ 10:00 đến 16:00 mà nhân viên được yêu cầu có mặt trong giờ làm việc linh hoạt.

Probationary Employees
Probationary employees are required to work full-time at the office for the first 60 days.

Unexcused Absence Policy
The Unexcused Absence Policy states that absence without reason for 3 consecutive days is considered voluntary resignation.

Meeting Agenda Policy
The Meeting Agenda Policy requires an agenda to be sent at least 24 hours before any meeting.

Punctuality Policy
The Punctuality Policy states that meetings should start on time, even if not all attendees are present.

Timekeeping Policy
The Timekeeping Policy requires employees to check-in/out via the HRM app using face ID or QR code.

Meeting Policy
The Meeting Policy outlines rules for meetings, including requiring an agenda, punctuality, clear action items, and avoiding meetings for issues solvable via Slack.

Late/Early Departure Policy
The Late/Early Departure Policy requires employees to inform their manager if they are more than 15 minutes late or leave early.

Action Items Policy
The Action Items Policy requires meetings to conclude with clear action items, specifying who does what and by when.

Internal Communication Policy
The Internal Communication Policy defines the primary channels for daily communication (Slack), formal information (Email), and work/technical documentation (Jira/Confluence).

Slack
Kênh chính cho giao tiếp hàng ngày, yêu cầu trả lời trong 2 giờ làm việc.

Respect For Non-Working Hours Policy
The Respect For Non-Working Hours Policy discourages expecting replies outside 9:00-18:00, except in urgent situations.

Confluence
Confluence is used for work management and technical documentation.<SEP>A platform where the Employee Handbook is located.<SEP>Công cụ được sử dụng để quản lý tài liệu kỹ thuật.

Feedback Culture
The Feedback Culture promotes direct and honest feedback, described as Radical Candor, and includes weekly 1:1 meetings.

Email
Kênh giao tiếp cho thông tin chính thức, khách hàng và đối tác, yêu cầu trả lời trong 1 ngày làm việc.

Jira
Jira is used for work management and technical documentation.<SEP>Công cụ được sử dụng để quản lý công việc.

Radical Candor
Khái niệm về văn hóa phản hồi thẳng thắn và trực tiếp.

Weekly 1:1 Meetings
Weekly 1:1 Meetings with managers are a space for feedback and discussion within the company's feedback culture.

Core Values
Core Values are the fundamental principles that guide Agentic House Vietnam's decisions and operations, including customer centricity and continuous learning.

HRM App
The HRM App is a mobile application used by employees for check-in and check-out for timekeeping purposes.

Flexible Work Policy
The Flexible Work Policy provides options for employees regarding work location and hours, encompassing Work From Home and Flexible Hours policies.

Work From Home (WFH)
Chính sách cho phép nhân viên làm việc tại nhà tối đa 2 ngày/tuần, áp dụng cho nhân viên đã qua thử việc và đạt đánh giá Đạt trở lên, cần sự đồng ý của Trưởng phòng.

Flexible Hours
Chính sách cho phép nhân viên bắt đầu làm việc từ 8:00–10:00 và kết thúc tương ứng, miễn có mặt trong "core hours" 10:00–16:00.

Ứng dụng được sử dụng để chấm công qua face ID hoặc QR code tại cửa ra vào.

Văn Hóa Agentic House
Bao gồm các quy tắc về cuộc họp, giao tiếp nội bộ và phản hồi, định hình cách làm việc tại Agentic House.

Agenda Cuộc Họp
Danh sách các chủ đề cần thảo luận trong một cuộc họp, cần được gửi trước ít nhất 24 giờ.

Văn hóa phản hồi thẳng thắn và trực tiếp (Radical Candor), bao gồm các buổi 1:1 hàng tuần với Trưởng phòng.
